 Prayer :-

This Petition is filed under Section 528 Bnss, to call fo
 records about the Fir bearing Crime No. 5 of 2018 on the file of Dc
 Police Station Trichy and quash the same as illegal against the
 petitioner/accused No.11.

For Petitioner : Mr.J.Karthik Eswaran,
 For Respondents : Mr.K.Sanjai Gandhi
 Government Advocate (Crl.Side) for R1

Order 
This Petition is filed to quash the impugned F.I.R registered for the offences under Section 417, 420,
120B and 506(i) I.P.C.

The learned Government Advocate (Crl.Side), on instructions, would submit that the investigation has now been completed and the final report would be filed within a period of one week.
3. Therefore, this Court is not inclined to quash the F.I.R. at this stage.

The first respondent is directed to file the final report within the one week from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and if the petitioner is aggrieved by the final report, she may challenge the same, in accordance with law.
